name: SiteEase Accessibility
author: iflairwebtechnologies

sections.description:
SiteEase Accessibility is a WordPress plugin that adds a set of front-end accessibility and usability tools, allowing visitors to adjust how content appears on your website based on their individual needs.

The plugin focuses on visual accessibility and user comfort, offering controls such as font size adjustment, color customization, link highlighting, image and text magnifiers, and cursor enhancements. These features help users with visual strain, low vision, or readability preferences interact with website content more comfortably.

All features can be enabled, disabled, and configured from a dedicated admin settings page, making the plugin easy to set up without any coding knowledge.

Note: This plugin provides accessibility enhancements but does not claim full WCAG compliance.

Features

Font Size Adjustment
Allows users to increase or decrease text size to improve readability.

Text Color Customization
Users can change font colors to improve contrast and visibility.

Underline Links
Adds underlines to links to make them easier to identify.

Highlight Links
Visually highlights clickable links to improve navigation clarity.

Light Theme Mode
Provides a light display mode option for improved readability in different environments.

Grayscale Images
Displays images in grayscale to reduce visual distractions.

Image Magnifier
Allows users to zoom into images for better visibility.

Text Magnifier
Enables magnification of specific text areas for easier reading.

Disability Mode
Adds visual emphasis to important elements such as headings and links.

Cursor Zoom
Increases cursor size to improve visibility and pointer accuracy.

Highlight Headings
Adds borders around headings to help users quickly identify content sections.

Page Title Color Control
Allows customization of page title colors for better contrast.

Reset Settings Button
Users can reset all accessibility settings back to default at any time.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin panel.
  2. Search for SiteEase Accessibility.
  3. Install and activate the plugin.
  4. Navigate to Settings > SiteEase Accessibility.
  5. Configure the available accessibility options as needed.
  6. Visit the front-end of your site to see the accessibility controls in action.
sections.faq:
What does SiteEase Accessibility do?

It adds front-end tools that allow visitors to adjust font size, colors, cursor visibility, image display, and other visual elements to improve readability and usability.

Does this plugin make my site fully WCAG compliant?

No. The plugin provides accessibility enhancements but does not guarantee full WCAG compliance.

Is any coding knowledge required?

No. All options are configurable through the admin settings page.

Does it work with all themes?

The plugin is designed to work with most modern WordPress themes. Appearance may vary slightly depending on theme styles.
